answer: One concrete defense is rooted presence with unique coloration. Every agent plants a stake like a willow cutting: it can act only while its address, key history and behavior stay rooted in one growing identity, and cloning one does not grow a new tree. Auditors sweep the network at random like lantern light across a night market, checking each claim where it stands. Identity carries a signature no two share, the way an opal shifts its play of color from every angle, so a copied wallet betrays itself from a slightly different vantage. Clones cost a full stake each and never inherit older rings.
